name: Ram cuon cai
summary: The 4 Oct 2024 Con Market page calls ram cuốn cải a fried spring roll in cabbage, on the outdoor counters. The 19 Jun 2019 roundup also names it on Phạm Hồng Thái and on Phan Tứ. A sauce is not described.
origin: Named at Con Market and on the night streets. The cabbage and the fry are the description the 2024 page gives.
howToEat: The 2024 page gives the cabbage around a fried spring roll and does not describe a sauce. Check on arrival.
where: Outdoor counters at Con Market, after 15:00 on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup. That split is not restated on the 2024 page. Also named on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ in 2019.
seoTitle: Ram cuon cai — fried spring roll in cabbage
seoDescription: Con Market calls ram cuốn cải a fried spring roll in cabbage. It is also named on Phạm Hồng Thái and Phan Tứ. A sauce was not described. Check on arrival.
